0.9.3-beta.0.en:
Maintenance: use adapter timer API (this.setTimeout/this.clearTimeout) so all timers are cleared on unload
Maintenance: translated the delete device confirmation message into all supported languages
Maintenance: raise Node.js to 22, modernise CI and release tooling, update dependencies, resolve repository checker findings
**CI/CD**: Fixed deployment failure by adding missing sentry-version-prefix parameter to GitHub Actions workflow
**CI/CD**: Updated GitHub Copilot instructions template from v0.4.2 to v0.5.6 - adds ESLint configuration, translation management, lint-first CI/CD workflow guidance
Dependencies updated to current versions

**FIXED**: A device that stays offline logs "Unable to initialise" as a warning once, further attempts are logged at debug level ([#788](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/788))
**FIXED**: Devices that are offline can be deleted from the instance settings again ([#787](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/787))
**ENHANCED**: Tests now also run on Node.js 26 ([#872](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/872))
**ENHANCED**: Updated @iobroker/testing to 6.3.0
Removed a broken README link ([#876](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/876))
**FIXED**: Writing a HEX colour sends the tertiary colour from `2_HEX` instead of `1_HEX` ([#906](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/906))
**FIXED**: Writing a 6-digit HEX colour keeps the current white channel instead of setting it to 255, an 8-digit HEX sets the white channel ([#907](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/907))
**FIXED**: `rawCommand` is only acknowledged when the device accepted the command, a failed request is logged as warning ([#908](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/908))
**FIXED**: Usermod data (`u`) in the state section is removed correctly, the object id contained a tab character ([#921](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/921))
**FIXED**: Segment mirroring `seg.N.mi` can be written ([#918](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/918))
**FIXED**: The `time` state can be written to set the module time (unix timestamp) as documented ([#919](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/919))
**FIXED**: The debug message "State attribute definition missing" is logged once per attribute instead of on every update ([#917](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/917))
**FIXED**: The websocket ping timer no longer resets the handle of the watchdog timer, so all timers are stopped correctly ([#902](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/902))
**FIXED**: Device Manager: deleting a device waits for the result, shows an error if it fails and works for instance numbers from 10 ([#914](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/914))
**FIXED**: Device Manager: adding a device that does not respond shows a message instead of failing silently ([#916](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/916))
**FIXED**: Adding a device checks the IP address range and reports a device that is already added instead of "failed" ([#915](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/915))
**FIXED**: An outage of a device is logged as one warning, reconnect attempts are logged at debug level ([#903](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/903))
**FIXED**: A command for a device that is offline or unknown logs a clear warning instead of an error reported to Sentry; commands sent by websocket are acknowledged ([#904](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/904))
**FIXED**: When the websocket connection of a device closes, `_info._online` is reset and the disconnect is logged again (regression since 0.7.2) ([#899](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/899))
**CHANGED**: `on` and `bri` keep their last value when a device goes offline or the adapter starts; the current values are read from the device on reconnect ([#899](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/899))
**FIXED**: `_info._online` turns `false` when a device did not answer for two polling intervals, as intended ([#900](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/900))
**FIXED**: Devices that are found or added after the adapter start are monitored by the watchdog (offline detection, reconnect) without a restart ([#901](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/901))
**FIXED**: Discover in the Device Manager stops the previous Bonjour search before starting a new one; README no longer mentions auto-detect cycles ([#905](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/905))
**FIXED**: A device name changed in ioBroker is kept; the WLED name is only taken over for new devices or when the name was not changed ([#910](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/910))
**FIXED**: The effect and palette lists of `fx` and `pal` are refreshed on every reconnect, new effects after a firmware update appear without restart ([#912](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/912))
**FIXED**: The reboot button `rb` is created for every device; `hp` and `rd` appear when the device provides them ([#911](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/911))
**FIXED**: Errors are logged once; the Sentry hand-over is only logged at debug level ([#913](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/913))
**FIXED**: `addSegment` checks segment id, `start` and `stop` (stop greater than start) and accepts numbers given as text ([#920](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/920))
The labels of the retry settings are part of the i18n translation files ([#922](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/922))
**FIXED**: Removed the unused setting `devices` from the instance configuration; devices are taken from the object tree ([#923](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/923))
**FIXED**: A polling interval below 1 second or an invalid number of retries is replaced by the default and logged as warning ([#924](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/924))
**FIXED**: Small corrections: device names with spaces in the settings table, device model without "undefined", typo in the connection state name ([#925](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/925))
**FIXED**: Segments added or removed in WLED are synchronised without restart; segment states are stored by their WLED segment id, so writing works when segment numbers have gaps ([#909](https://github.com/DrozmotiX/ioBroker.wled/issues/909))
